mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO tool (tool_name, description, source,audit_remark, auditor_id,created_user) VALUES
(#{item.toolName}, #{item.description}, #{item.source},#{item.auditRemark}, #{item.auditorId},#{item.createdUser})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE description = VALUES(description), source = VALUES(source)
mapper.select: SELECT tool_name AS toolName, source, audit_remark AS auditRemark, auditor_id AS auditorId FROM tool WHERE tool_name = #{toolName} AND deleted = 0
